messages:
leo: Quick preflight — enterprise prospect (FinOps Inc) is asking for commit sizing guidance. They expect a sustained 2500 qps chat workload with 95th tail SLA 200ms for generation. Any red flags on reserved GPU sizing or autoscale policy?
ayana: Do we have their typical sequence length / prompt sizes? 200ms SLA is tight for many models.
sahil: They said avg tokens per request ~60, peaks to 400 for long-form. Workload mix: 70% chat, 20% embedding lookups, 10% rerank.
maya: For 2500 qps sustained we need to decide per-model concurrency. If they use a 7B quantized model, rough estimate: 1 GPU can handle ~350 qps with low-latency config (aggressive batching off). So ~8 GPUs reserved baseline, add headroom.
leo: pricing question from customer: can we show cost delta between reserved pool of 10 GPUs vs 6 reserved + burst credits? They want predictable cost but not overcommit.
kelsey: Recommend reserved 8 + burst pool of 4 for AZ failover and spikes. That gives baseline + 60% burst headroom. We should also propose autoscale cooldowns: 30s scale-up + 5m scale-down to avoid thrash.
tom: Security Q: FinOps needs KMS integration + audit logs + VPC. They asked whether Private deployment required for audit or Dedicated enough.
ayana: Dedicated supports customer VPC peering + KMS integration on our enterprise plan. Private is only for air-gapped/on-prem.
sahil: Operational note: KV-cache warmup on chat leads to coldstart tail. For 2500 qps sustained, plan a proactive KV warm-up job during preheat windows. We can provide a small warmup harness.
leo: Can someone sketch an ops playbook I can share with customer? Short checklist they can sign off on.
maya: Quick checklist: 1) traffic profile + seq length sample, 2) reserve 8 GPUs, 3) configure burst credit pool 4 GPUs, 4) preheat KV cache with replayed prompts, 5) set autoscale cooldown 30s/5m, 6) AZ spread >=2, 7) SLO runbook + fallback model (smaller quantized) for overload.
sahil: Fallback model idea: have a 3B quantized variant pinned as a graceful fallback. Router policy: try primary, if queueing >100ms or CPU/GPU util >85% switch to fallback.
kelsey: Pricing note: finance prefers presenting two options: (A) Reserved 10 GPUs monthly (all-in fixed) (B) Reserved 8 + burst credits (lower fixed + metered bursts). I'll draft numbers.
leo: @maya @sahil can you help with a concrete perf table (latency vs GPUs) for the 7B and 3B models? customer asked for numbers at 50/200/500 tokens.
maya: On it. I can run a quick perf sweep tomorrow and attach a CSV. Expect 7B (50t): p50 ~40ms p95 ~160ms on T4-like perf profile per GPU at 350 qps, 3B will be ~25/100.
tom: For security questionnaire: I can answer KMS/audit/VPC Qs. If they push for full SOC2 docs we have that but need to coordinate with legal.
leo: Awesome — last ask: can we include a simple failure-mode matrix for the presales doc? e.g., GPU OOM, AZ outage, queue buildup and our fallback.
sahil: I'll write a 1-pager. Short entries with mitigation steps.
deploybot: build-notify: loadtest/enterprise-sim succeeded — 8gpu baseline sim @2500 qps, 95th latency 190ms (model: 7B quantized).
leo: Perfect. I'll send the checklist + options to FinOps tomorrow morning. Thanks all :raised_hands:
